title: domain-skill/v1 body
description: agent-knowledge-governance-json-spec.md §4.4 — the skill document IS a Markdown file, and akg stores it verbatim (user decision 2026-09-21). `name` is the document id and the directory the SKILL.md lands in; `markdown` is the author's text, unparsed. The heading structure inside it (## 한 줄 설명 / ## 언제 호출되는가? / ## 도메인 지식 / ## 데이터, and ### <id> — <title> items with ```sql or ```ask fences) is the consumer's schema (fdc-agent-be-spring SkillMarkdownTool); akg only refuses an `##` section it does not know (envelope.mjs semantic check), so a typo fails at push instead of silently dropping a section downstream. Unknown keys are rejected so the four-cell JSON shape this replaced (questions/needs/queries/...) fails loudly rather than being stored as dead weight.

name.description: Skill name = document id = rendered/domain-skill/<name>/SKILL.md. The consumer names the skill after this, not after the md's h1.

markdown.description: The whole skill document as the author wrote it. Stored and served byte-for-byte; the renderer only prefixes a SKILL.md frontmatter.
